decisions.reason: The cross-Requirement effect is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting same_phone_used_for_message_and_gameplay to true.
The instruction to follow the script reiterates the existing adherence rule; the same-phone demonstration change does not alter this Requirement.
The source repeats the required Igbo phrase but does not change the existing Igbo-language requirement; the device change is semantically separate.
The same-message deadline instruction is already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY, and the demonstration-device change creates no additional deadline impact.
